response.original_title: [Complete Guide] How to Dispute an Unauthorized Charge with Virgin Voyages Cruise?
response.overview: To dispute a charge with Virgin Voyages, you can contact Sailor Services directly by calling +1 (866) 254-7549 in the US/Canada or emailing sailorservices@virginvoyages.com.While Onboard Visit Deck 5 & Check the App: Review your folio at the Sailor Services desk on Deck 5 or monitor real-time spending in the "My Wallet" section of the app.After Your CruiseContact Support: Call +1 (866) 254-7549 (US/Canada) or +44 (12) 0420-8151, or email your receipts and details to sailorservices@virginvoyages.com.Escalate or Dispute: +1 (866) 254-7549 Ask your travel advisor (First Mate) to escalate the issue internally, or +1 (866) 254-7549 file a formal dispute with your credit card issuer if unresolved
